programme.desc: Nostalgia aims to represent Chinese traditional culture by revealing life in villages in the way of story-telling. In this show, the audience can enjoy the natural and cultural backgrounds. (怀念是以讲故事的方式展示中国传统文化,以揭示村庄的生活.)

programme.title: Across the Strait ((海峡两岸（中央电视台涉台时事新闻评论栏目）))
programme.desc: This program details the China Governments policy of one country. (报告中详细介绍了中国政府对一个国家的政策.)

programme.title: China News ((China 收播新闻))
programme.desc: Catch the latest news and social changes that are moving China and the world. (获取最新的新闻和社会变化,)

programme.title: Focus Today ((今日关注（中央电视台中文国际频道深度时事新闻评论栏目）))
programme.desc: The programme traces the latest development of the current affairs around China. (该计划追踪了中国当前事件的最新发展.)

programme.title: Around China ((电影眼漫游中国))
programme.desc: Enter a world where the true essence of China blossoms and you will begin to understand how this great nation has evolved. (进入一个中国真正的世界,你会开始理解这个伟大的国家是如何发展的.)

programme.title: Network News ((Network 收播新闻))
programme.desc: Network News is a 30-minute news program which features news on China and the world. (网络新闻是一个30分钟的新闻节目,)

programme.title: Classical Theatre ((中文))
programme.desc: This broad selection of drama series genres includes romance, military and family connections, captured in Chinas great classics. (这种广泛的戏剧系列类型包括浪漫,军事和家庭联系,)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms ((新一剪梅))
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses parents enter into the picture. (三个单身的女人和他们爱上的人认为事情是简单的,幸福的,直到女孩的父母进入了这个画面.)

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress ((萧十一郎))
programme.desc: A woman sets up a troubled love triangle involving 2 swordsmen Ti Lung and Lau Wing and an enchanting lady Ching Li. (一个女人搭建了一个麻烦的爱情三角形 涉及两个剑客提龙和刘荣 还有一位迷人的清丽女士)

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow ((女秀才))
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her familys pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman. (一个年轻的女人,她生活在男孩的身影中,)

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword ((浣花洗剑录))
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess. (士们的冲突是士们的故事,)

programme.title: Na Cha the Great ((哪吒‎))
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor. (一个年轻的叛军在重生后进入传说中,)

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot ((少林海燈大師))
programme.desc: Alongside the equally famous Lo Lieh, superstar David Chiang plays noble warrior monk Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple. (超级明星戴维·清扮演了崇高的战士僧侣奇希·希姆,拯救了南方沙olin寺的僧侣.)

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperors Power ((封神劫))
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him. (王朝的李王子和他的妻子李兰被流亡后,他自杀了.)

programme.title: Pale Passion ((我为你狂))
programme.desc: Chiang Li Ping plays a scorned wife, while Elaine Chin Yen Ling is the mistress who teaches the hypocritical husband that what goes around, comes around. (李平扮演一个被视的妻子,而伊莱恩是女主人,)

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber ((霹雳十杰))
programme.desc: In this unofficial third sequel to The 36th Chamber of Shaolin, San Te Gordon Liu is given the task of training Fong Sai Yuk. (在"沙olin的第36室"的第三部无正式续集中,圣特戈登被赋予训练Fong Sai Yuk的任务.)

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty ((江山美人))
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor. (捕捉超级明星,琳达林戴, 在这个故事中最受欢迎的角色,)

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden ((小龙女))
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story. (旧和新的混合在一起,创造了一个遥远的时代动作爱情故事.)

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft ((邪斗邪))
programme.desc: After a compulsive gamblers wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife. (博的妻子离开他后,他得到了一个美丽的鬼作为他的新妻子.)

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio ((边城三侠))
programme.desc: A trio of heroes go up against a power-hungry Ming Dynasty official and also cross paths with three beauties. (一组英雄与一个渴望权力的明朝官员相,)

programme.title: Madam White Snake ((新白蛇传))
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union. (在佛教僧侣打破他们的结婚之前,一个以人形的惊人的蛇女神勾引了一个年轻学者.)

programme.title: Young Vagabond ((少年苏乞儿))
programme.desc: A wine shop owners son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge? (一个葡萄酒店老板的儿子,在私人教师中找到了一个精彩的武术教练,)

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late. (林达扮演了一个被骗的美女,为了中国人民而牺牲自己.)

programme.title: Love Parade ((璇宫艳史))
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designers creations, but love follows regardless. (医生批评时尚设计师的创作时, 闪的光线会飞翔,)

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother ((书剑恩仇录))
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement. (这部史诗描述了陈洛和他的士兵如何说服清皇帝隆承认他的汉血统并加入反清运动.)

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee ((新陈三五娘))
programme.desc: The films curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty. (电影的奇怪标题指的是两个道具, 标志着一个幸福的开始,)

programme.title: The Fastest Sword ((天下第一剑))
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry Kings famous 1950s film about a persecuted swordsman. (从作家导演潘·莱来看,这部关于一个被迫害的剑手的汉尼·金斯1950年代著名电影的中国版本.)

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆下江南))
programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lungs adventures in Jiang Nan. (根据民间传说,导演李汉希安介绍了江南的汉王的冒险.)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The iron triangle comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic. (导演长切和明星戴维·清和蒂隆组成的铁三角形,)

programme.title: Sweet and Wild ((野姑娘))
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous. (由于剧情扭曲,身份错误,以及一些惊人的音乐数字,)

programme.title: The Dragon Creek ((龙虎沟))
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer. (在她第一部角色中,虎,隐藏龙恶人成佩佩扮演了功夫的南西德鲁,)

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again ((乌龙济公))
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other! (在这部续集中,疯狂僧侣被无死学者变成天才的卢平加入,)

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yongs novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons.

programme.title: My Wife Is A Gambling Maestro ((我的老婆是赌圣))
programme.desc: Gambling queen, Ying Ying who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition and rescued by Gerrard but suffering from amnesia, she decided recover in time to compete in the big event! (博女王英,她是亚洲博者神竞赛的竞争者,)

programme.title: The Goldfinger ((《金手指》潮流))
programme.desc: Based on Hong Kongs biggest financial scandal of Ching Yat Yin, who rises from rags to become a billionaire. An ICAC investigator spends 15 years to uncover the truth behind his rapid rise in wealth. (根据香港最大的金融丑闻, 雅从子上为亿万富翁.)

programme.title: Burning Blood ((热血燃烧))
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal. (警方背叛了一名毒品团员,在逮捕一名毒品主管时,他死亡.)

programme.title: Reunion Dinner (聚会晚餐)
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control. (当一个订婚夫妇被要求邀请父母参加CNY客户活动时,与母亲疏远的未婚夫假装了家庭.)

programme.title: My First Of May ((无名指))
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughters muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope. (前南瓜冠军邓格(Teng)和他的妻子被女儿们的肌肉萎缩所摧残。 几年后,她的小手指微弱的动向给了她们一个微小但强大的希望信号。)

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story ((阖家辣))
programme.desc: Coba turns his mothers chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity. (科巴在整个家庭的帮助下,在疫情期间,把他的母亲的汁变成了流行商品.)

programme.title: Panda Plan ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hus caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains. (传奇功夫明星杰基采用了一只熊猫叫胡胡. 当犯罪集团给熊猫提供奖励时,杰基,他的代理人和胡胡监护人开始寻求超越恶棍的任务.)

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures ((那些年，我们一起疯狂的事))
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends decide to do something unforgettable and take on a seemingly impossible challenge - winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives. (五个高中朋友在毕业前决定做一件令人难忘的事, 接受一个似乎不可能的挑战, 赢得一场重要篮球比赛,)

programme.title: Shock Wave (冲击波)
programme.desc: Superstar Andy Lau stars as a bomb specialist set on capturing a wanted criminal called Blast in this action-drama. However, will he be able to do it in time when Blast threatens a massacre? (超级明星刘刘星作为炸弹专家 准备在这场闹剧中抓获一个叫爆炸的通缉犯)

programme.title: Welcome To My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a breakup and an accident, Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks. It is only when he meets Jia Nan that her presence chases them away and sparks an absurd yet sweet romance. (在分手和意外之后,小周被一群摇摇欲坠的橡皮鸭缠住了。 只有当他见到贾南时,她才将她们赶走,并点燃荒谬而甜蜜的爱情。)

programme.title: Raging Fire (愤怒的火)
programme.desc: Starring Donnie Yen, Nicholas Tse, an inspector discovers that the team of masked thugs who killed his co-workers are led by a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. (导演:唐尼·,一名检查员发现, 杀害他的同事的伪装暴徒团队由一位前警察领导,)

programme.title: Mamas Affair ((巨星养成记))
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life. (由前人才经理Mei Fung Kearen Pang导演的香港戏剧, 退休照顾丈夫的儿子,)

programme.title: The Last Tycoon ((最后的大亨))
programme.desc: Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghais most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind? (一个杂货店员被制,被迫离开他所爱的一切,最终成为上海最强大的暴徒老板之一.)

programme.title: Table for Six 2 ((还是觉得你最好2))
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved! (伯纳德和在年长哥哥不在的时候打算结婚.然而,婚礼变成了混乱的战场,家庭剧情不断升级,这给所有参与者带来了混乱的事件!)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive. (在悲痛和愤怒的驱使下,他们找到了一个残酷的贩运集团,把他们的孩子活着带回家。)

programme.title: The Phantom Lover ((夜半歌声))
programme.desc: It is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community! (这是一位歌手和一个富裕的女孩,)

programme.title: Everything is Unknown ((意外人生))
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming must attend his fathers funeral to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and her family, but ended up falling into their trap. (潘明必须参加父亲的葬礼,以夺取巨大的遗产.)

programme.title: Tainted Love ((无法抗拒的爱))
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammers clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds. (周兰被网上约会骗局所欺骗.她追踪骗子的线索,她到达一个沿海小镇,遇到两个年轻人.)

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette ((手卷烟))
programme.desc: In this Golden Horse winner starring Gordon Lam, a retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian drug mule. (在这个主演戈登·兰的金马奖得主,一位退休的英国-中国士兵成为一个三人团的猎人目标,)

programme.title: Silent Code ((沉默代码~监狱的密约~ - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Reporter Lan research news from across a popular BBS forum. Xiang, a forum founder, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas but being the subject of heated debate due to a leaked video. (记者兰从一个受欢迎的BBS论坛中研究新闻.,一个论坛创始人,为网民创造了分享梦想和想法的空间,)

programme.title: The White Storm 2 Drug Lords ((扫毒2：天地对决))
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau Louis Koo, a bounty of USD 100 million awaits those who successfully capture the biggest drug dealer in Hong Kong. (在这场史诗般的行动中, 以刘刘路易斯·库为主的幕后主演的安迪·劳·路易·库, 一笔一亿美元的赏金,)

programme.title: Eastern Inspiration Ep04 (东部呼吸Ep04)
programme.desc: Prestige Chinese documentary production, tackling serious subjects with the best cinematography, editing, and all round production values with a unique Chinese perspective. (位中国纪录片制作,以最好的影视,编辑和具有独特的中国视角的全面生产价值来解决严的主题.)

programme.title: Archaeologists Mysterious Tools Ep02 (神秘工具Ep02)
programme.desc: A documentary series showcasing the history of China and its people. (展示中国及其人民的历史.)

programme.title: Victory: 1931-1945 Ep08 ((圣罗 Victory: 1931-1945 Ep08))
programme.desc: A documentary series featuring historical and archaeological exploration. (一部纪录片系列,涉及历史和考古探索.)

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou Foodwise: Shaoguan (食物: 尚图)
programme.desc: Food connects people! A feast for the eyes that spotlights the cuisines of China in a way thats bound to set the mouths of the whole globe watering! (食物连接着人们! 一个眼睛盛宴,以一种方式突出中国的美食,)

programme.title: Foreign Entrepreneurs in the Chinese Market Ep04 (中国市场的外国企业家)
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: Chinese Dragon Boat Ep03 (中国龙船Ep03)
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form. (精心制作的短片纪录片,讲述了中国各个方面的故事!)

programme.title: Potala Palace Ep07 ((布达拉宫 Ep07))
programme.desc: Documentaries in this slot are rebroadcasts of our most-viewed and most popular stories of the season. They feature important social, economic, environmental affecting lives nationwide. (据此,该片中的纪录片是我们本季最受欢迎的故事的重播.)

programme.title: National Highway G331:The Jilin Section Ep01 (国家公路G331:吉林路Ep01)
programme.desc: A strand devoted to the nature and wildlife of China, the people who lived alongside them, and the great and diverse landscapes with which they all contend. (专注于中国的自然和野生动物,)

programme.title: Travelers on the Silk Road Ep04 (丝绸之路旅行者Ep04)
programme.desc: Real life stories told from the personal perspective. Moving, dramatic, sorrows and joys, expressed emphatically and expressed quietly. Watch closely to see and understand the real China as it is lived. (故事讲述了真实的生活,从个人角度讲述. 动作,戏剧性,悲伤和喜悦,强调和静地表达.)

programme.title: Murder in the 21st Ep06 (谋杀案在21年)

programme.title: Murder at the Motel Ep06 ((地狱旅馆（加拿大2025年亚当·麦克唐纳执导的恐怖电视剧） Ep06))
programme.desc: January 5, 2016, Baltimore, MD. Police officers respond to a report of a deceased man found at the Deluxe Plaza Motel in Northeast Baltimore. (2016年1月5日,巴尔的摩市警方回应了在巴尔的摩东北部的豪华广场汽车旅馆发现一名死者的报告.)

programme.title: Booked: First Day in S2 Ep10 (预订:S2 Ep10的第一天)
programme.desc: A man charged with his fourth DUI rages against the machine, and a mom, whos a first-time arrestee, contemplates life as a possible convicted felon. In Modesto, a man is accused of felony arson. (一名男子被指控第四次驾驶醉酒, 激怒了机器, 一个母亲, 首次被捕, 考虑生活,)

programme.title: After the First 48 S16 Ep116 (在第一 48 S16 Ep116)

programme.title: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception Ep03 (谎言探测器:真相或欺骗 Ep03)
programme.desc: Edward Ates takes a polygraph test with former FBI agent George Olivo in a bid to show his innocence. He spent 20 years behind bars for the murder of his neighbour-a crime he says he didnt commit. (爱德华·阿特斯与前联邦调查局特工乔治·奥利沃进行了多边测试,试图证明他无辜.他因谋杀邻居而被监禁了20年.)

programme.title: The Life Murder of Nicole Brown Simpson Ep02 ((The 终生惩戒 Murder of Nicole Brown Simpson Ep02))
programme.desc: After years of torment, Nicole files for divorce, embarking on a new chapter that includes a risky affair with one of OJs close friends. But a failed reconciliation led Nicole to a final, fatal stand. (经过多年的痛苦,尼可尔申请离婚,开始了新的章节,其中包括与奥杰的一个亲密朋友的风险性关系.)

programme.title: Sleeping With a Killer S2 Ep09 ((睡个好觉ing With a Killer S2 Ep09))

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. Why do my feet hurt?, he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them why is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They dont understand what hes doing and think its funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through t

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: Whats that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? Its the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Harbin Ice City, China
programme.desc: When Grim HQs heating gets stuck on, Glitch looks for a cold place to land and cool down. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the cool sights of Harbin Ice City in China. Every year sculptors at the festival create realistic models of world-famous landmarks from blocks of ice, and Lars is attempting to carve the Eiffel Tower. Suddenly the sculptures around them begin to melt. The team investigates wh

programme.title: Roots Fruits S01 - Parsley
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Parsley sings a rock song.

programme.title: Roots Fruits S01 - Pepper
programme.desc: Pepper performs a bell ringing act.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Robotato
programme.desc: Evil Pea has trapped Supertato and replaced him with an evil robot lookalike called Robotato.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Yi Yi Xiang Bei Feng - EP4
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lians affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of Infernal Affairs are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sams wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lulas Last Stand Triple Trouble
programme.desc: Little Lula has set up a lemonade stand, but shes not getting any business. The Zenkos swing into action to send customers her way. When Donna, Fawna and Rona have a spat, the triplets longstanding annual tradition of viewing a comet together is in jeopardy. Now its up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Accidental Hero Rich Kid Ra
programme.desc: Accidental Hero In order to win the Fright Stuff Award, Casper consults his uncles for scaring advice. Rich Kid Ra When Ra pulls up to Scare School in a solid gold chariot, everyone suddenly wants to be his best friend.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Dragon Quest Opposite Day
programme.desc: Dragon Quest The unlucky staff of a medieval-themed restaurant in Deedstown, get an unfriendly visit from Professor Thurdigree Burns. Opposite Day When Wolfies experiment with moonlight goes awry, everyone but Casper turns into his or her opposite.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: Its time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lolas nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelps Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelps fun-crastinating puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Pupcakes Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch cant keep up with the demand. Tag and Scoochs race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: Its Ball-entines Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, theyre invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove theyre kind and helpful.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Daks lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leylas overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Best Fans Forever
programme.desc: The gang heads to Best Fans Day at NYs Giraffe Stadium, where Alex gets caught up in the attention of rooting for the winning team. When his behavior ends up hurting Martys feelings, Alex comes to learn that the only team that matters is the one thats made up of his friends.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Gloriasaurus
programme.desc: The gang heads to the Museum of Dinosaurs. But Gloria becomes obsessed with her handheld video game and misses out on whats in front of her, and ends up creating a disaster of colossal proportions.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Cloudy With A Chance Of Hugs Creek Week
programme.desc: The Trolls share a special hug with a special Troll on Hug DayWhen Creek returns to Troll Village everyone is willing to forgive him except Branch.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - The Giver Bellow Bug Day
programme.desc: Poppy attempts to discover which troll has been giving out yearly gifts at the Harvest MoonWhen Poppy accidentally ruins a Troll holiday her attempt to fix things keeps leading to more disasters.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Rough Ride
programme.desc: The PALs join AI and Javier on a mustang drive, but when Javier gets injured, its up to Lucky and Spirit to get him to safety

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Ghostly Gotcha!
programme.desc: When Snips claims not to be afraid of ghosts, the PALs decide to give him a fun Halloween scare hell never forget!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimis not exactly who she says she is. Our villains alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Verucas mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Verucas rekindled powers.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Slow Boat to England
programme.desc: Po and Blade head to the docks to take Klaus and Veruca to England, and Po tries to have fun with her on their last day together. However, Klaus and Veruca break free and hold Po hostage Blade shockingly gives up the location of the fire whip to save him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect Dudes Weekend camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Play It Again, Tim
programme.desc: When Tim is forced to take piano lessons, he actually enjoys them and Boss Baby realizes that Tim is being brainwashed by his piano teacher, slowly turning Tim into an old man

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Research Developments
programme.desc: Turtleneck wants to crack the Stinkless Serum formula and makes it a competition, pitting worker babies against worker babies, stating that the first one to the Serum will be the new CEO!

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Rescue
programme.desc: Tonys been kidnapped..by Sudarikov! The rest of the team must break into the plane where Tonys being held and rescue him all while 30,000 feet in the air!

programme.desc: The kids must leave Po to escape into the forest and head back to Panda Village to prepare against Jindiao

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Secrets Lost to Shadow
programme.desc: The kids meet an unlikely ally when trying to find Po

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Out of the Cave and Onto Thin Ice
programme.desc: After a shocking revelation, Po is determined to get his chi back and Jing decides to face Jindiao

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Remote Control
programme.desc: Bored of the viewing options on window, Thunk realizes what hes been missing real life drama! But when Thunk starts creating drama around the farm, the others set out to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Daddy Daughter Day
programme.desc: Sandy is finally old enough to join Grug and Eep for the annual Daddy Daughter Day and Grug couldnt be more excited. But when Sandy struggles to fit in with Grug and Eeps traditions, Grug has second thoughts. It isnt until Sandy goes missing that Grug realizes its time to start a new tradition.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Theres No Phil in Team
programme.desc: When Phil humiliates himself playing throw-go-nut with the punch monkeys, the Croods band together to help him regain his confidence. Unfortunately, Phil goes from confident to cocky and bets the farm on a game of throw-go-nut with the punch monkeys. Can the Croods overcome the punch monkeys - and Phil - to save the farm?

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Sting It On!
programme.desc: Tom must rescue Olivia from the Hidden World when she winds up getting herself frozen by a pack of hungry Speed Stingers.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Deep Freeze
programme.desc: When a deep freeze puts the lives of everyone in Rakke Town in jeopardy, the riders must attempt to use the dragons to get the humans through the night without being seen.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Jins New Look
programme.desc: On the brink of his highly-anticipated White Coat Ceremony at school, Jin proudly dons his new white doctors coat around town, unwittingly drawing the attention of a creature named Morty. After a slobbery lick from Morty, Jin turns invisible! As Jin frantically tries to become re-visible, he discovers that Morty is very pregnant! Ultimately, Jin foregoes his ceremony and instead delivers Mortys

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - A Cabbage Kinda Day
programme.desc: Already stretched thin between responsibilities, Yi discovers one of Mortys babies still in her building. She attempts to juggle her various responsibilities dumpling shop work, violin, magical creature childcare!, but its too much and she accidentally loses Mini-Morty. Shes going to need help from Jin and Peng to find Mini-Morty and return the baby creature to her mother.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Big Flap
programme.desc: Liam drives his cousin, then his other two podmates nuts when he refuses to let any of them know whats in the mysterious box hes been carrying around. When school newspaper editor Jason Ablinsky gets the mix, the fear of public exposure hikes the stakes and the race is on. And no one has ANY idea what Liams carrying.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Finding Neko
programme.desc: Birchs cat Neko disappears on Liams watch. Realizing that finding the AWOL feline is too big a job for just one guy, Liam has to convince a reluctant Sandra and Raffi. Liam is afraid that failure to locate the kitty escape artist will mean facing his cousins eternal wrath.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Raffi Raffle
programme.desc: The girls steal Liams fundraising to raffle off Raffi. Unfortunately, Principal Lemmon, who hates anything remotely fun is on Birch and Sandras trail as the two girls try to pull off a successful fundraiser and complete part of their civics studies.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Crushed
programme.desc: An unsigned note puts Birch into detective mode. With Sandra standing by to ridicule her, Birch tries to lure her shy admirer into the open. Will the guy secretly crushing on Birch be revealed or will Sandra get the last laugh?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And Her Alien Brother
programme.desc: After a trip to the planetarium, Ians knowledge about space and his peculiar behaviour lead Olivia to believe that her brother is an alien. Olivia soon discovers his secrethes making a special gift for his favourite sister

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plants A Garden
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmuller distributes seeds for a class garden project, Olivia just cant wait for her plants to grow. But when her dog Perry digs up her little garden, Olivia discovers something even more exciting what appears to be a dinosaur bone!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Claus
programme.desc: Its almost Christmas, and Olivia and Ian cant wait for Santa to come. But theres one thing that Santa cant bring Olivias lost toy, her beloved monkey Mathilda. Olivia imagines herself to be a Santa Claus who returns lost toys. On Christmas morning Olivia finds new gifts under the tree and Mathilda right under her nose.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Takes Ballet
programme.desc: Olivia is determined to dance just like the ballerinas shes seen in a ballet the only thing she needs is a partner. Luckily, Uncle Garret a professional football player is visiting, and the two of them dance a surprisingly graceful pas de deux for Olivias whole class.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. When Captain Meow Meow gets a splinter in his paw and hears the word vet, he flees. Now its up to the Dew Drops to find Captain Meow Meow and get that splinter out.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Pet Project Mission Improbable
programme.desc: When Mr. Tanaka adopts an unruly dog at Sams behest, the Zenkos have the job of training the mischievous mutt and turning him into mans best friend material. When Ellies friend Maria is late submitting her painting to the art show, its up to the Zenkos to get inside the community center after hours, avoiding overzealous junior security Rodney, and get Marias painting on display before the s

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - An Inconvenient Tooth Up, Up and Away
programme.desc: After Lula loses her loose tooth in the park, Team Zenko must find the missing molar and get it under Lulas pillow in time for the Tooth Fairys visit. Gabriel and Luis show off their new drone but it crash lands on the roof top. Team Zenkos mission is to try and get it back, but Yolanda wont give up her new hi-tech friend that easily.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Scare Scouts Boo
programme.desc: Scare Scouts When Frankengymteacher forms a scout troop, Casper is the first to sign up. Boo! During a visit to Deedstown, Casper and his friends are shocked to find the humans dressed as scary creaturesit must Halloween!

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Abra-Ca-Deedstown Shrinky Dust
programme.desc: Abra-Ca-Deedstown From cleaning Ras sarcophagus, to starring in Jimmys magic act, Casper has been helping so much, hes exhausted. Shrinky Dust When magical Shrinky Dust falls into Norman the bullys hands, Casper and Jimmy find themselves on a hunt to get it back.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when theres no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the Whoopsies! Song.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Mailed Away The Wandering Wand
programme.desc: When Harper unknowingly drops her cooking camp application on the way to post office, its up to the Dew Drops to get it into that big blue mailbox. When Cassie accidentally places Lolas beloved, old toy wand in a box marked for a giveaway drive in the park, the Dew Drops must find a way to retrieve the wand before it ends up in the hands of an entirely new family.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Lucky Penny Hammys Day Out
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. Now its up to the Dew Drops to get the penny across town and back into Marcus pocket before showtime. When Nicholas rolls the hamster ball with Hammy inside out into the streets, the Dew Drops must get Hammy back home safely.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Moms Birthday Angry
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruzs help to perform a dance for Moms birthday. Though its hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tuskist Three Moon Festival
programme.desc: Scallop is afraid of her first tuskist appointment. Kelp helps her get through it with a song. Fog rolls in, threatening Kelps first Three Moon Festival in Unicorn Land. Kelp and his friends use a combination of unicorn spark and the Kelp Way to create a new festival.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Ding Dong Day Grand Sam
programme.desc: Its Pawstons annual Take Your Kid to Work Day, and its Tags year to spend the day at the Doorbell Store with Paw. Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to complete an obstacle course in the woods.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Clucky Day Take Me Out to the Fetch Game
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because hes missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. When theres a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, its up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they dont have to forfeit.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he cant get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where Theres Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Fang-Tastic Halloween
programme.desc: After hearing spooky rumors about the new habitat resident- A BAT- Marty is determined to protect his friends from the newcomer. But when the bat helps him out of a tough situation, Marty learns its better to get to know someone rather than judge them on false stereotypes.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Tale of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Alex is mistaken for a Maine Coon and takes over that cats life in the penthouse. At first, VERY comfortable with his shmancy new life, Alex grows to miss his old life and learns that its lonely at the top.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Prank Day Adventures In Dinkles-Sitting
programme.desc: When Branch declares himself Prank Master Poppy gets evenTaking care of Mr. Dinkles is a bit harder than expected for Securityobsessed Branch.

programme.desc: Convinced Troll Village is dangerous Branch makes a security plantPoppy creates an apology monster out of Gristle when teaching him how to make amends.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knights Fall Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knights Fall Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blades life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhminis hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years shes been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Wrinkles Stickles
programme.desc: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying fun house at the town fair

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Bossa Nova
programme.desc: After Boss Baby is fired from Baby Corphe attempts to navigate regular baby life in a MommyDaddyBaby playgroup. Even worsethe playgroups other new member is Mega Fatwhose animatronic stuffie Wagby malfunctions and threatens the safety of the whole group. MeanwhileTim does everything he can to avoid doing his homework.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Museum Job
programme.desc: When the crowded bathroom situation at the local museum threatens baby loveBoss Baby leads his new team of playgroup babies on their first missionand then their SECOND mission after a klepto baby in their group swipes a priceless artifact. In a continued attempt to avoid homeworkTim joins Boss Baby on his mission.

programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 铁子瓹山窿 今日知多D Her Railway Trip Whats On Today
programme.desc: 第7集n倪嘉雯 体验江户时代做枪技艺亲亲海豚n嘉雯这回化身专注观赏铁道的铁子见る铁，欣赏穿梭市内的百年铁道阪堺电车她更踏着单车追逐电车，兴奋得忍不住向列车打招呼nn途中，她走进自江户时代保留至今的枪械制作工场，透过互动游戏体验古老的做枪技艺，玩得十分投入景点一转，嘉雯又连番拜师学习磨刀技巧与刀柄制作，深切感受到师傅们的职人精神nn接着来到海豚互动馆，嘉雯下水参与海豚训练，并向牠献出屏幕初吻nn是日行程终站，嘉雯选择以茗茶放松身心.

programme.title: 死有对证 Cause Of Death

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司銷售經理林信丁子朗飾時裝店老闆夏莉馮盈盈飾同居多時，愛情漸變平淡，兩人對將來也存在分歧情侶間日積月累的矛盾不滿一發不可收拾，林信夏莉爆發激烈爭吵下引致車禍經歷生死一剎後，踏實賢淑的夏莉變得熱情率性，事事以林信為中心，甚至介入其圈子，為林信的姊姊林善車婉婉飾上司麥美娜姚嘉妮飾競敵駱偉滔張頴康飾好兄弟穆家傑馬貫東飾和區文黃庭鋒飾帶來巨大衝擊！林信縱跟夏莉重拾初相識的浪漫與情愫，但眼前的她猶如判若兩人，林信不禁思疑對方還是否真愛？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: Orang Itu
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki yang berpandangan prejudis menghalau seorang wanita gelandangan yang tidur di belakang restorannya. Beliau terkejut apabila isterinya membawa wanita itu ke rumah mereka untuk tinggal bersama.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Haziq meluru keluar dari kereta apabila melihat Aisyah jatuh dan tangan Aisyah luka berdarah. Manakala Iskandar hanya duduk di dalam kereta dan tidak menghiraukan apa yang terjadi. Haziq menawarkan pada Aisyah untuk pergi ke klinik, belum sempat Aisyah bersetuju Iskandar sudah keluar dari kereta dan marah disebabkan menunggu. Aisyah terkejut dengan sikap Iskandar lalu menolak perlawaan Haziq. Aisyah memberitahu Ros tentang Iskandar dan Ros menganggap bahawa lelaki kaya seperti Iskandar tidak pernah peduli akan perasaan sesama manusia tetapi hanya pada harta. Kepulangan Aisyah di rumah dalam keadaan tangan yang luka membuatkan Fasha lebih suka mengenakan Aisyah. Dia meminta Aisyah melakukan segala kerja meskipun kerja itu sudah diselesaikan oleh Aisyah awal pagi lagi. Mak su Ainin akan sentiasa menjadi penyokong Fasha dalam membuli Aisyah. Sementara itu, Tengku Maria begitu marah dengan kepergiaan Iskandar yang meninggalkan TG Holdings semata mahukan ketenangan selepas Tengku Maria memaksanya berkahwin dengan Tengku Waiduri. Tengku Maria meminta Iskandar balik dengan segera jika mahukan jawatan CEO TG Holdings itu diserahkan padanya. Namun Iskandar berdegil dan mahu Tengku Maria membatalkan niat untuk menyatukan Tengku Waiduri dengannya. Hubungan tegang antara Tengku Maria dan Iskandar membawa malapetaka pada Iskandar apabila dia hampir terlanggar Aisyah yang ketika itu sedang berlari dalam hujan akibat mahu menyelamatkan diri daripada diperkosa oleh Farid.

programme.title: Mr Delicious
programme.desc: Aiman menyedari makna sebenar cinta, bukan sekadar memiliki tetapi memahami.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlan menerima panggilan dari seorang perempuan yang menggelarkan dirinya bidadari dunia yang berminat dengan ustaz Jazlan dan keesokan harinya beliau menerima makanan pulut kuning dari bidadari dunia tersebut. Sakinah datang ke rumah Alawiyah untuk menawarkan khidmatnya dalam penganjuran majlis-majlis tausiyah samada di masjid ataupun di rumah. Di Majlis Buka Kitab yang diadakan di rumah Alawiyah, Aishah begitu teruja kerana diberi peluang untuk mempersembahkan Marhabannya dan Qasih pula terasa apabila diperli oleh ustaz kerana tidak menumpukan perhatian semasa kuliah berlangsung

Alawiyah berasa sungguh hairan kerana setiap hari menerima bungkusan untuk Jazlan dari bidadri dunia. Jazlan terjumpa Qasih yang tersidai tepi jalan akibat kereta beliau rosak lalu terpaksa bantu menghantar Qasih ke kolej. Alawiyah dan Khatijah akan mencadangkan kepada anak-anak mereka untuk bertunang sebelum Jazlan ke Madinah

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah rebah di dalam hujan. Iskandar meminta Haziq untuk membiarkan Aisyah pengsan bersendirian tetapi sekali lagi Haziq memaksa Iskandar untuk bersikap perikemanusiaan. Iskandar mengalah dan mereka terpaksa membawa Aisyah ke homestay mereka untuk di rawat. Di homestay mereka buntu bagaimana untuk menguruskan Aisyah yang masih pengsan. Haziq meminta Iskandar menjaga Aisyah sementara dia pergi memanggil empunya homestay iaitu kak Wan. Belum sempat kak Wan dan Haziq tiba di homestay, orang kampung sudah tiba dahulu di homestay itu dan menangkap Iskandar dan Aisyah yang sedang berdua. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha memarahi Farid kerana mahu merogol Aisyah. Takut diketahui orang ramai, Mak Su Ainin yang melihat kejadian Aisyah berlari keluar kerana hampir dirogol oleh Farid itu terus membuat perancangan mengenakan Aisyah bagi menutup malu. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha dan ke homestay dengan berpura-pura sedih dan kecewa atas kelakuan Aisyah. Aisyah dan Iskandar menafikan mereka berkhalwat, penjelasan demi penjelasan di berikan namun tiada siapa yang percaya. Mak Su Ainin meminta Aisyah dan Iskandar berkahwin pada malam itu juga.

programme.title: Rojak
programme.desc: Rojak adalah sebuah rancangan yang membawa pelbagai jenis informasi yang mendedahkan orang awam kepada benda yang mereka tidak biasanya akan cuba dari eksperimen sosial, D.I.Y. dan lain-lain lagi. Dihoskan oleh Leaism.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Deanna mencuba pelbagai idea gila bagi mencari pengganti untuk pengantin lelaki. Dalam masa yang sama, katerer pilihan Deanna pula mahu menarik diri dan Khai terpaksa membuat satu tawaran yang mustahil akan ditolak.

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Rasya minta tempoh untuk berfikir sebab tak nak kecewakan opah yang susah payah menjaga dirinya. Reeza Rasya pula semakin mesra. Reeza teman Rasya beli kereta. Fahmi dapat tahu Rasya nak beli kereta. Fahmi offer diri nak teman tapi Rasya mengelak. Reeza dan Rasya terserempak dengan TA TM di sebuah restoran.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China
programme.desc: Selepas Perang China-Jepun, Army of the Rising Sun cuba untuk menguasai wilayah Guangdong dengan sebuah organisasi rahsia. Guru Seni Mempertahankan Diri Wong Fei-Hung dan pelajar-pelajarnya cuba menghentikan serangan ini.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Black S1 EP1
programme.desc: Detektif Khairul Malik menyimpan sebuah rahsia, yang teman wanitanya, Aisya tidak tahu mengenainya. Perkara menjadi rumit dengan penemuan mayat dua puluh tahun, yang menggerakkan rangkaian kejadian yang membawa maut. Kehidupannya berubah secara mendadak apabila dia bertemu Sofia, gadis yang berkebolehan meramal kematian orang. Apabila dia meramal sebuah tragedi dahsyat, Sofia mendapat perhatian polis dan juga seorang keturunan usahawan insurans ulung, Lokman Nazir. Tertarik dengan bakat unik Sofia, Malik meyakinkan dia untuk bekerja bersamanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, tetapi niat baik mereka menyebabkan tragedi. Sementara itu, penghantaran sebuah pita menyebabkan huru-hara dalam hubungan Malik dan Aisya apabila rahsia gelap Aisya mula terungkai.

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Black S1 EP1
programme.desc: Detektif Khairul Malik menyimpan sebuah rahsia, yang teman wanitanya, Aisya tidak tahu mengenainya. Perkara menjadi rumit dengan penemuan mayat dua puluh tahun, yang menggerakkan rangkaian kejadian yang membawa maut. Kehidupannya berubah secara mendadak apabila dia bertemu Sofia, gadis yang berkebolehan meramal kematian orang. Apabila dia meramal sebuah tragedi dahsyat, Sofia mendapat perhatian polis dan juga seorang keturunan usahawan insurans ulung, Lokman Nazir. Tertarik dengan bakat unik Sofia, Malik meyakinkan dia untuk bekerja bersamanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, tetapi niat baik mereka menyebabkan tragedi. programme.title: Black S1 EP2

Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP11
programme.desc: Cikgu Zaiton pengsan selepas ternampak lembaga seakan-akan Wan Peah di hadapan rumah Cikgu Siti semasa pulang dari kedai. Tok Hashim kemudiannya mengadakan sembahyang hajat dan doa selamat. Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton tidak habis-habis menyalahkan Cikgu Siti yang kononnya memakai menyebabkan huru-hara di kampung mereka. Selepas solat hajat, Nurin yang merasa bersalah mengaku dialah yang menakut-nakutkan Cikgu Zaiton pada malam tersebut. Farhan semasa berkelah dengan Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabatnya di Bukit Berapit mendapati Aishah tiba-tiba hilang.

programme.desc: Podcast Jejak Merdeka dihostkan oleh Amin Idris membicarakan tentang Islam Mekar di Bumi Malaysia bersama-sama panel jemputan Dato Dr. Sirajuddin Suhaimee.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.
