Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.desc: Seorang wanita dijodohksn dengan lelaki pilihan keluarganya. Namun, perjodohan tersebut mambawa kepada kejadian-kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang menggangu kehidupannya.

programme.title: DAcademy 7 Mega Konser: Boyband x Girlband
programme.desc: Sebuah konsert khas yang penuh bertenaga, menampilkan para peserta DAcademy 7 dalam persembahan berkumpulan sebagai kumpulan lelaki dan kumpulan wanita. Konsert ini menyerlahkan kebolehan serba boleh mereka menerusi koreografi seirama dan harmoni moden, dengan menggabungkan tenaga muzik pop masa kini bersama identiti tersendiri DAcademy 7.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Aku Teperdaya Topeng Keluarga Sempurna
programme.desc: Rani menyangka perkahwinannya dengan Reza bakal membawa kebahagiaan yang diimpikan. Namun selepas berkahwin, dia mula menyedari bahawa keluarga Reza yang kelihatan sempurna dan sangat menjaga nama baik sebenarnya menyimpan sisi lain yang tidak pernah diduganya. Rani bukan sahaja sukar diterima oleh keluarga suaminya, malah terpaksa berdepan pelbagai tekanan yang mengubah kehidupan rumah tangganya menjadi penuh penderitaan.

programme.title: THE KINGS LETTERS ((国之语音))
programme.desc: King Sejong desires to create an original alphabet for his people. With the help of others, they struggle to create the Korean alphabet Hangul. (随着其他人的帮助,他们努力创造韩国字母汉古尔.)

programme.title: NEW TRIAL ((法律与秩序：陪审团))
programme.desc: A lawyer in debt finds new meaning to his job when hes enlisted by a young man to clear his name after spending 10 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. (一个债务律师在一个年轻人招募他,)

programme.title: ITS OKAY! ((没事))
programme.desc: In-young loses her mother in an accident and is kicked out by the landlord. Her chief choreographer has no choice but to bring her home. Facing adversity, the two gradually become closer. (在一场事故中失去了母亲,房东把她赶出去.她的主编编舞员别无选择,只能带她回家.面对逆境,他们逐渐变得更亲密.)

programme.title: MY DAUGHTER IS A ZOMBIE ((我和我的僵尸女儿))
programme.desc: Jung-hwans daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter. (Jung-whans女儿Soo-ah感染了僵尸病毒。他注意到她似乎仍然能理解语言,因此他吸取了动物训练的经验来指导他的僵尸女儿。)

programme.title: TRAIN TO BUSAN ((釜山行))
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan. (在韩国爆发尸病毒时,乘客包括父亲和小女儿,一对夫妇和几名学生在于在首尔到布山的火车上扎.)

programme.title: HOPELESS ((无奖竞猜))
programme.desc: Yeon-gyu has never gotten what he wanted in life. With Chi-geons help, he joins the gang and struggles to hold on to hope, but soon finds himself facing even more dangerous situations. (-从来没有得到他想要的东西. 凭借奇帮的帮助,他加入了帮派,并努力坚持希望,)

programme.title: A TAXI DRIVER ((出租车司机艳遇记))
programme.desc: A widowed father and taxi driver takes a German reporter from Seoul to Gwangju to cover the 1980 uprising. (一个寡妇父亲和出租车司机将一位德国记者从首尔带到广州报道1980年起义.)

programme.title: BOTTOM OF THE WATER ((水鬼))
programme.desc: Ga-youngs sister died six year ago. One day, Ga-young is chased by a vengeful water spirit who appears as her sister. She strives to solve the mystery of her sisters tragic death. (六年前,Ga-youngs的姐姐去世了.有一天,Ga-young被一个复仇的水灵追赶,她扮演了她的姐姐.)

programme.title: THE LIMIT ((惊爆死亡线))
programme.desc: Policewoman So-eun stands in as the mother of a kidnapped child. The kidnpaper demands to negotiate with her as So-eun and not as the stand-in for the kidnapped childs mother... (女警素恩作为被绑架孩子的母亲站在那里。)

programme.title: THE LOST CHOICES (失去的选择)
programme.desc: A young woman who has speech disorder is raped while on her way home. The police do not believe in her. She is frustrated and thus triggers her silent revenge against the world. (一位有言语障碍的年轻妇女在回家的路上被强奸,警察不相信她,她沮丧,因此引发了对世界的无声报复。)

programme.title: DECISION TO LEAVE ((分手的决心))
programme.desc: When detective Hae-Joon investigates the death of a man who fell from a mountaintop and meets his wife Seo-rae, he starts to suspect her at the same time that he begins feeling an attraction to her. (当侦探 Hae-Joon调查从山顶下跌的男子死亡, 遇见他的妻子 Seo-rae, 他开始怀疑她,)

programme.title: THE MAN FROM NOWHERE (没有人)
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hopes of saving the child who is his only friend. (一个安静的当铺管家 带着暴力的过去 抢走了毒品和器官贩运圈 希望能拯救他唯一的朋友)

programme.title: THE ATTORNEY ((辩护人))
programme.desc: When tax attorney Song Woo-Suk agrees to defend a student activist who was arrested and tortured into giving a false confession, his entire life and worldview begin to change drastically. (当税务律师伍苏克同意捍卫一名被捕并被折磨为假承认的学生活动人士时,)

programme.title: ONCE WE WERE US ((後來的我們))
programme.desc: Former lovers Eun-ho and Jeong-won unexpectedly reunite on a flight to Korea, giving them a second chance to reminisce about their past and share long-buried words with each other. (让他们有第二次机会回想起自己的过去, 并彼此分享长久的言辞。)

programme.title: OMNISCIENT READER: THE PROPHECY ((全知读者视角))
programme.desc: Dok-ja is the only reader of an obscure web novel for 10 years. Suddenly, the apocalyptic world of the novel becomes reality. He and the novels omnipotent hero strive to save the world. (东贾是10年来唯一读过一个模糊的网络小说的读者.突然间,小说的末日世界成为现实.他和小说的全能英雄努力拯救世界.)

programme.title: VICTORY ((圣罗 Victory))
programme.desc: In 1999, Pil-sun and Mi-na team up with cheerleader Se-hyeon to form the cheerleading team Millennium Girls with seven other girls for their high school soccer team, aiming for victory. (1999年,皮尔孙和米娜与啦啦队长谢合作,为他们的高中足球队组成了"千一代女孩"啦队队,)

programme.title: MIDNIGHT RUNNERS ((青年警察：午夜跑者))
programme.desc: Two students from Korean National Police University decide to work together and track down a kidnapping incident. (两名韩国国家警察大学的学生决定一起追踪绑架事件.)

programme.title: Want To De-stress (想摆脱压力)
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health. (许多城市居民都在为生活和职业生涯而努力,没有时间放松,积累的压力会迅速引发健康问题。这个计划邀请各个领域的专业人员,如芳香疗法师、音乐治疗师、彩色治疗师、营养学家和心理学家,使用无障碍的方法,包括案例研究和有趣的测验,以体现五感的和谐与平衡,帮助观众立即释放压力。这个计划还将邀请名人与东道方进行坦率的对话,分享他们应对生活和工作沉重压力的有效方法。这个计划还包括许多有趣的减压提示,以加深观众对减压对健康的重要性的理解。)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View ((热带雨))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. (报道关于香港,跨海和国际事务的重要新闻.)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo ((澳门街))
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.title: The Truth Within ((剥茧))
programme.desc: Haunted by his girlfriends suspicious death in a car crash, young forensic examiner Qi Sizhe transfers to a major crimes unit to find the truth. Teaming up with detective Zhu Qingyue and officer Han Feng, he investigates a series of bizarre murders. Through forensic evidence, they discover that every crime connects to an illegal synthetic drug ring called Original Diamondthe masterminds behind his girlfriends death. (年轻的法医奇思哲(Qi Sizhe)以他的女友们在车祸中疑似死亡为借口,将他转到一个重大犯罪股寻找真相。他与侦探朱青雨和韩峰警官合作,调查了一系列奇怪的谋杀事件。通过法医证据,他们发现每一个犯罪都与一个非法合成毒品团伙有关,这个团伙名叫“原钻石集团 ” 。)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: EXTRA ((E.T.外星人))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kongs entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment. (报道有关香港,跨海峡和国际事务的重要新闻.每天晚上都会随时了解香港娱乐业的最新消息,以及来自世界各地的电影和娱乐新闻.我们报道艺术家的最新发展,电视剧和电影的促销,音乐会的亮点,以及大奖典礼的报道.我们甚至出国观看大型娱乐活动,追踪国际电影明星,并与知名歌手,演员和电视人物进行独家访谈.)

programme.title: News Roundup ((现在不是出轨的问题))
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports. (报道来自香港,台湾海峡及世界各地的重大新闻,以及体育新闻,)

programme.title: Global View ((世界观))
programme.desc: Global View, curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspectivebroadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge. (全球视觉由经验丰富的记者编辑,引导你以全球视角看待世界,扩大你的视野,扩大你的新闻理解,并丰富你的知识.)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo ((澳门街))
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today ((News At 18:30 Global View 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.title: The Truth Within ((剥茧))
programme.desc: Haunted by his girlfriends suspicious death in a car crash, young forensic examiner Qi Sizhe transfers to a major crimes unit to find the truth. Teaming up with detective Zhu Qingyue and officer Han Feng, he investigates a series of bizarre murders. Through forensic evidence, they discover that every crime connects to an illegal synthetic drug ring called Original Diamondthe masterminds behind his girlfriends death. (年轻的法医奇思哲(Qi Sizhe)以他的女友们在车祸中疑似死亡为借口,将他转到一个重大犯罪股寻找真相。他与侦探朱青雨和韩峰警官合作,调查了一系列奇怪的谋杀事件。通过法医证据,他们发现每一个犯罪都与一个非法合成毒品团伙有关,这个团伙名叫“原钻石集团 ” 。)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: EXTRA ((E.T.外星人))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kongs entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sects Zhang Chui Shans son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government.

programme.title: My Wife is a Gambling Maestro ((我的老婆是赌圣))
programme.desc: Natalie Yao Meng stars as the gambling queen, Ying Ying, who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition. But before the competition she is betrayed by her fianc and left for dead. Rescued by a young man called Gerrard, who suffering from amnesia, Ying Ying, must recover in time to compete in the big event! (娜塔莉·姚孟星(Natalie Yao Meng Stars)作为赌王皇后,英英(Ying Ying)是亚洲赌神竞赛的对手。 但在比赛之前,她被未婚夫背叛,然后被送去死。 一个名叫Gerrard的年轻人,他患有失忆症,英英英(Ying Ying Ying)必须及时康复才能在大赛中竞争!)

programme.title: The Goldfinger ((《金手指》潮流))
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kongs biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Chings wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth. (20世纪80年代在香港最大的金融丑闻的启发下,这是一桩关于上市公司总裁程亚丁的豪华故事。 有了青春的财富和对上升的影响,国际廉政公署高级调查员刘开勇决心调查此案,即使这意味着要花15年时间去寻求真相。)

programme.title: Burning Blood ((热血燃烧))
programme.desc: Narcotics squad membersTai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tangare involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel. (缉毒队成员Tai Hua、Lao Mi、Ah Feng和Ah Tangare参与逮捕一名毒枭。 然而,警方内部的背叛导致Ah Feng及其上司死亡,而Ah Tang则消失。 当Tai Hua和Laa Mi揭开真相时,他们在打击毒品卡特尔的斗争中发现忠心与背叛之间被撕裂。)

programme.title: Reunion Dinner (聚会晚餐)
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity. (Chao Yang和Zi Hong很快就要结婚了,但双方都没有见到其他父母。 当客户请求为宣传其产品而提供一次同学会晚餐的活流时,这为他们父母的首次会面铺平了道路。 与母亲不同,杨决定为晚餐租个家庭,这导致一系列的不幸和分裂。)

programme.title: My First of May ((无名指))
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife face devastating trials when their daughter is diagnosed with muscular dystrophy and his mother with cancer. Years later, as the family struggles between holding on and letting go, they find a new connection through a small but powerful sign of hope: the faint movement of their daughters pinky finger. (前南瓜冠军邓格及其妻子在被诊断为肌肉萎缩和母亲患癌症时面临毁灭性的考验。 几年后,当家人在坚持和放手之间挣扎时,他们通过一个微小但强大的希望信号找到了新的联系:她们女儿的手指微弱移动。)

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story ((阖家辣))
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mothers chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination. (Coba被迫在COVID-19期间在家里工作,每天与家人争吵,他决定把母亲的辣椒酱变成一种时髦商品,以维持家人的生计,他的母亲、父亲和姨妈一起做辣椒酱,家庭在网上销售,商业发展超出他们的想象。)

programme.title: Panda Plan ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: After legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts the panda Hu Hu, an international crime syndicate places a massive bounty on the bear. Joined by his agent and Hu Hus caretaker, Jackie embarks on a daring quest to outsmart the villains. (在传说中的功夫明星成龙成龙(Jackie Chan)采用熊猫胡胡胡(熊猫胡胡)之后,一个国际犯罪辛迪加将巨额赏金加在那只熊身上。 Jackie在他的代理人和Hu Hus 看守员的配合下,勇敢地追求超越坏人。)

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures ((那些年，我们一起疯狂的事))
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends - Jia Yi, Kopi, Uncle, Wawa and Ah Di - decide to do something unforgettable together. Chasing dreams, friendship and youthful passion, they take on a seemingly impossible challenge, winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives and shape their future forever. (毕业前,五个高中朋友Jia Yi、Kopi、Uncle、Wawa和Ah Di决定一起做一件令人难忘的事情。 他们追求梦想、友谊和青春的激情,面对着似乎不可能的挑战,赢得了一场关键的篮球比赛,这可以改变他们的生活,塑造他们永远的未来。)

programme.title: Shock Wave (冲击波)
programme.desc: Bomb specialist Cheung Choi San sets out to capture a wanted criminal called Blast. However, will he be able to do it in time before Blast kills hundreds of citizens inside Hong Kongs busiest Cross Harbour Tunnel and destroys everything in his quest for revenge? (炸弹专家张崔桑准备逮捕一个叫爆炸犯的通缉犯。 但是,他能否在爆炸杀死香港最繁忙的横渡港隧道中的数百名公民并摧毁他为复仇而作的一切之前及时这样做?)

programme.title: Welcome to My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways. (陈小周在痛苦的分手和奇特的事故后,被一群只有他能看见的摇摇晃晃晃的橡皮鸭缠住了。 每当他和欢乐的冯佳南在一起时,他的怪咒就会消失。 随着他们的亲近,一个荒谬而又令人心动的浪漫花花,以出乎意料的方式改变了他们的生活。)

programme.title: Raging Fire (愤怒的火)
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score (当警察开始逮捕一名毒品主,一支面具暴徒偷走了毒品并杀害了警察.检查员邦被摧毁看到屠杀后果,很快发现杀手是由恩戈领导的,一位前警察被迫进入犯罪生活.)

programme.title: Mamas Affair ((巨星养成记))
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching. (前任人才经理Mei Fung退休后留在家里照顾丈夫和儿子。 她决定重新进入娱乐行业以寻找她的生活价值,并成功地将当地一家餐厅的送餐男孩Fong Ching变成一个年轻的偶像。 这让她十几岁的儿子Jonathan非常嫉妒Fong Ching。)

programme.title: The Last Tycoon ((最后的大亨))
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war. (黑帮手陈达升上了权力的上层阶层,但发现自己被两名女性的爱情,秘密服务的谋杀阴谋和迫在眉的战争威胁之间撕裂.)

programme.title: Table for Six 2 ((还是觉得你最好2))
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved. (布纳德和在婚礼期间结婚,但婚礼却变成了混乱的战场,家庭剧情不断升级,为所有参与者造成混乱的事件.)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive? (在愤怒和悲痛的驱使下,他们开始一场无序的暴力斗争,以追击残酷的贩运集团。 他们能摧毁犯罪团伙,让孩子活着回家吗?)

programme.title: The Phantom Lover ((夜半歌声))
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community. (1926年,中国有才华的歌手宋英俊深爱着来自富裕家庭的可爱的无辜女孩托,他们的爱激起了托斯父亲的强烈反对,也引起了她指定的未婚夫的强烈嫉妒,未婚夫是她家庭所选择的一位年轻男子。 这是一个关于一名歌手和一个富人女子在传统社区中争吵在一起的故事。)

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown ((意外人生))
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap (潘仪明的父亲会收到父亲的来函,说他必须在家里参加葬礼,以获得巨大的遗产。当他回家时,他遇到了他的前女友、她的丈夫华琦和女儿,而他从未见过她们。 当潘仪明发现他的女儿被华婆虐待时,他发誓要救她,但最终会落入他们的陷阱。)

programme.title: Tainted Love ((无法抗拒的爱))
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan. (办公室的Zhou Ran女士成为网上约会爱情骗局的受害者,并被550,000元骗骗。 在骗徒留下微弱线索后,Zhou Ran来到一个小沿海城镇,遇到了两个年轻人。 她逐渐发现这两个男人隐藏了骗局的线索,并提出了她的报复计划。)

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette ((手卷烟))
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live together, the two men transcend conflicts and cultural differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood. (一位退休的英中士兵在抓走一个携带一袋被盗毒品的南亚青年男子时成为三合会追捕的目标。 两人被迫共同生活,他们超越冲突和文化差异,在这个充满忠诚和兄弟情谊的壮观故事中形成美丽的友谊。)

programme.title: Silent Code ((沉默代码~监狱的密约~ - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem... (兰记者的任务是研究互联网新闻, 并穿越BBS热门论坛,梦想董事会。论坛创始人项项为网民分享梦想和想法创造了空间, 但最终却因视频泄露而成为激烈辩论的主题。 兰记者为真相挖掘真相时, 她发现事情比看上去复杂得多。)

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords ((扫毒2：天地对决))
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau and Louis Koo, the two award-winning best actors star on opposing sides of a drug war. As a bounty of 100 million Hong Kong dollars is made to hunt down the biggest drug dealer in the city, Hong Kong becomes the battleground for the fight between good and evil. (在这场史诗般的表演中,刘刘华和高路易(Louis Koo)是获奖的两位最佳演员,在一场毒品战争的对立面上出演。 由于一亿港元的赏金被用来追捕本市最大的毒贩,香港成为了正义与邪恶斗争的战场。)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms ((新一剪梅))
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia. (Shaw Brothers中一些1970年代最大的女性明星 分享了这个年轻爱情和干扰父母的故事 主角是Lily Li、Shu Pei Pei和Essie Lin Chia。)

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress ((萧十一郎))
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao. (故事发生在一个武术世界里,每个人都试图获得鹿剑。 连安的妻子在伏击中受伤,他的对手小晓救了她。她们逃到小施家,他治疗她的毒伤。这导致连怀疑妻子的忠诚,导致与小晓发生几次流血决斗。)

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow ((女秀才))
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her! (华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情)

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword ((浣花洗剑录))
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot (水族首领在大湖一年一度的决斗前不久,被一名武士杀手严重打伤,他派哥哥宝羽远途寻找解药。 在路上,宝玉遇到了小公主,爱上了她,不知道她隐藏了一个秘密阴谋。)

programme.title: Na Cha The Great ((哪吒‎))
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor. (纳查的故事是 3000 年前的.纳查为了拯救父母而牺牲了自己的生命后,他被他的精神转身在莲花中,并用两个魔术武器武装,拯救人民免受暴君的皇帝.)

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot ((少林海燈大師))
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time. (少林少林教主派和尚奇三去向吴当神父学习特别的武术,他在清和明阵营的战斗中被蒙骗,必须同时召集门徒重建被烧焦的少林寺庙。)

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power ((封神劫))
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army? (唐最后一位统治者李耀耀被成朝的创始人赵国俊推翻。不幸的是,他的行动在法院和人民中引发了一场新的瘟疫,他的哥哥宽义。强奸和掠夺。随着更多的人卷入其中,它变成了血腥的背叛战场。应该由李朗这样的正直的官员来结束它。但是,一个人能接受帝国军队吗?)

programme.title: Pale Passion ((我为你狂))
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back (花芳是一位执着的男人,他爱他的妻子阿霞,但很容易嫉妒和虐待她。有一天,当她离开他时,她和另一个女人Hsing勾搭了另一个女人Hsing。当她再次进入阿霞并决定赢回她时,一个致命的三角关系就会发展出来。)

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber ((霹雳十杰))
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too. (刘高登在最后的三部曲中, 在试图保护方世玉时, 重现了自己的著名角色, 圣德僧人,他试图保护方世玉,)

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty ((江山美人))
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved... (成德皇帝在访问中国南部时遇见了国女李峰,一见钟情,皇帝在离开时承诺李峰会成为他的压抑品。当他一年后派去李峰时,她病得无法忍受艰难的旅程,及时抵达,无法在心爱的怀中死去。)

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden ((小龙女))
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry himonly for her to refuse his proposal. (杨国和小龙国深爱并和谐地在古墓中生活。小龙国提出结婚,但杨国不结婚。她心碎,一言不发地离开。因她缺席,杨国国不知疲倦地寻找她。当他们最后团聚时,他求她嫁给他,让她拒绝求婚。)

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft ((邪斗邪))
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment. (一个有不良运气的强迫博者欠钱一个暴力的帮派老板,他把他的妻子作为首付,让她离开他.)

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio ((边城三侠))
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates! (一群农民被当地地方法官压迫,他们绑架了一名地方法官的女儿,希望当局听取他们的意见。 一个流浪的剑客向他伸出援手,帮助他。 两名战士从压迫者转向被压迫者。 三重战者反击地方法官。)

programme.title: Madam White Snake ((新白蛇传))
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split... (琳达林戴是完美的作为帕克苏,一个惊人的蛇女神,她以女性的形式,以至于她可以品尝人类生活的快乐!帕克诱惑年轻学者,Hsu Hsien当她承认他作为她的救主在另一个生命1000年前.)

programme.title: Young Vagabond ((少年苏乞儿))
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge. (苏卡(Su Can)是一位酒主的无忧无虑而又不诚实的长子,在被开除出学校后被迫由教师指导学习。 他很快就发现他的老师是武术大师,成为他的门徒。 然而,当他的家人和主人被无情的土匪(Centipede, Su Can)杀害时,他的家人和主人开始危险地寻求报复。)

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself. (王赵军拒绝贿赂帝国画家,因此他画了一张她丑陋的肖像,阻止她被皇帝选中,直到他们见面。 画家最终流亡在外,并阴谋让王朝嫁给洪军阀,以报仇。 皇帝拒绝了这一提议,挑起一场战争,只有王王自祭才能避免战争。)

programme.title: Love Parade ((璇宫艳史))
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love (时装设计师史诗请他的朋友梅美评论他的新设计,但因她的批评而愤怒。 当穆伊要求他为她设计一件礼服参加一场盛会活动时,史美通过制作小丑服装进行报复。 看到米丝尴尬,史美感到内疚,在恋爱前向她道歉。)

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother ((书剑恩仇录))
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles (皇帝强龙并非生来王位的合法继承者,但他只有在两个颠覆性反政府秘密组织的高级成员多年后与他联系时才知道真相。 诚如事实,这个组织的主管是秦龙的弟弟,他们现在必须相互对抗,扮演对立的角色。)

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee ((新陈三五娘))
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide. (黄梅歌剧情中的奇怪标题是指两个道具,表明学者和当地美女之间有一个幸福的开始.学者抛光镜子,以接近他的爱情,谁通过扔一些子来表示她的认可.从那时起,他们的爱情变得摇滚,满满谋杀和自杀.)

programme.title: The Fastest Sword ((天下第一剑))
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally? (南剑客丁(Southern Swordsman Ting)名为“最快之剑 ”, 但却被街头和尚打败,必须履行他的承诺,在与和尚一起渴望的石碑上工作三年。 之后,丁回到家乡过着和平的生活,并减少了所有挑战。 即使如此,他还是被迫与北剑侠作战。谁能最终获胜?)

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆下江南))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter. (龙皇帝不知名地前往江南审查他人民的生计,但很快发现腐败官员正在压迫他的人民.皇帝遇到了一个正直的年轻人,他们携手教腐败官员一个教训.年轻人被任命为他的保卫.)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive. (宋朝的王子被钦族入侵者抓获,由武术大师顶尖看守。 有两个强大的爱国者需要克服巨大的困难,拉出不可能的:拯救王储并活着离开钦族据点。)

programme.title: Sweet And Wild ((野姑娘))
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back? (是一个的村子女孩,她不怕反击暴徒.她遇到了最大的子的麻烦,当她与女仆打败他的计划时,让策划复仇.)

programme.title: The Dragon Creek ((龙虎沟))
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer. (这部Wuxia谋杀神秘片讲述了一位年轻女孩的父亲在中国早期共和时代遭到无情谋杀。 她有一张恶棍的名单,他们一直在密谋反对她的父亲,并且与她的哥哥一起,这位年轻女孩开始寻找秘密的连环杀手。)

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again ((乌龙济公))
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins. (活佛吉骨和不朽的Lu Dong Bin沉浸在凡人世界中,数名妇女的命运引发了一场争斗。 当这两个神灵在三次奇特的竞赛中展示其力量时,一系列可笑的不幸事件发生了。 在浪漫纠缠中,不朽者和人类之间开始了一场史诗般的战斗。)

programme.title: Ghazi
programme.desc: In 1971, an Indian Naval submarine, S21, intercepts a Pakistani submarine, PNS Ghazi, during routine surveillance and thwarts its mission of destroying INS Vikrant.

programme.title: Naradan
programme.desc: The dramatic journey of Chandraprakash, a popular news anchor in the media world who is desperate to prove his worth.

programme.title: Star
programme.desc: Follows a youngster Kalai and his aspirations of becoming a Star in the Tamil Film Industry. Born in a lower-middle-class family, will Kalai overcome all his struggles to emerge as a Star?

programme.title: Bhola Shankar
programme.desc: In Kolkata, a taxi driver fights to build a new life with his sister, but his dark past catches up with him as he battles the citys dangerous underworld.

programme.title: Malaysia To Amnesia
programme.desc: Fed up with his married life, Arun starts an extra-marital affair and soon leaves for Malaysia to meet his girlfriend. However, things take a turn when he lands up in Chennai suffering from amnesia.

programme.title: Danny
programme.desc: Police inspector Kunthavai teams up with Danny, a clever police dog, to solve a murder mystery involving a dangerous gang of serial killers in this thrilling investigation.

programme.title: Dhilluku Dhuddu 2
programme.desc: In a bid to escape from Vijis antics, his neighbours lure him to fall in love with Maya. However, everything turns upside down when he realises that a ghost is protecting Maya.

programme.title: Pongaluku Varugirom
programme.desc: Ex-cop Y.D. Raju agrees to assist his ex-girlfriend ACP Meenakshi in a high-profile kidnapping case. He finds himself in a fix when his wife, Bhagyalakshmi, insists on accompanying them.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kalki 2898 Ad
programme.desc: The future of those in the dystopian city of Kasi is altered when the destined arrival of Lord Vishnus final avatar launches a war against darkness.

programme.title: Katteri
programme.desc: Treasure-seeking crooks venture to a hillside village for gold but are unprepared for the mysterious and astonishing sights they encounter.

programme.title: Nenjam Marappathillai
programme.desc: Mariam, a woman raised in an orphanage, is offered a job as a caretaker for a child from a rich family. However, she is sexually exploited by her employer and returns as a spirit to exact revenge.

programme.title: Adhe Kangal
programme.desc: Varun Murali, a restaurant owner, falls in love with his customer Deepa. However his life takes an unusual turn after he realises the truth about her.

programme.title: India Pakistan
programme.desc: Two aspiring lawyers, not knowing that both are of the same profession, share the same office. Things take a turn when they work on the same case.

programme.title: Rummy
programme.desc: College students Shakthi and Joseph fall for sisters. Family discovers, sparking a battle to protect honor. Love, loyalty, and sacrifice collide in a fight for respect and tradition.

programme.title: Wild Dog
programme.desc: A series of deadly attacks occur that pose a threat to national security. In response, a brash but brilliant intelligence agent leads a covert operation to find the perpetrators.

programme.title: NCIS ((海军罪案调查处))
programme.desc: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy lieutenant found dead at a blood donation bank. Also, McGee needs help from the team to raise money for his twins school fundraiser. (NCIS调查了一名海军中尉在捐血银行被发现死亡的案件。 另外,McGee需要团队的帮助来为其双胞胎学校募捐募捐。)

programme.title: NCIS ((海军罪案调查处))
programme.desc: When Torres receives a text from Jimmys daughter who has discovered a large sum of money near the naval library, the team works together to investigate. (当Torres收到Jimms女儿的短信 她发现一大笔钱 在海军图书馆附近)

programme.title: La La Land ((爱乐之城))

programme.title: The Masked Singer U.K. ((蒙面歌王（美版）))

programme.desc: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis. (帕特里克·贝特曼,一个在华尔街工作的年轻人,在他的父亲公司杀人没有任何理由.每天,他的对世界的仇恨越来越强烈.这个令人难以置信的黑暗喜剧是基于布雷特·伊斯顿·埃利斯的书.)

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood ((第一滴血2))

programme.desc: Robson joins Carol Smillie in the Scottish Highlands for a day of outdoor adventures. At Loch Earne, they try a traditional boat known as a coracle and then make Iron Age-style clay pots. (Robson与苏格兰高地的Carol Smillie一起参加一天的户外冒险。在Loch Ene,他们尝试了一条传统船,称为铁器,然后制造铁器时代式的粘土锅。)

programme.title: Big Adventures: Into Thailand with Sue Perkins (伟大的冒险:与苏·珀金斯一起去泰国)
programme.desc: Sue reaches the final episode with a visit to the countrys heady and exotic capital, Bangkok. (苏以访问该国繁忙而异国化的首都曼谷来完成最后一集.)

programme.title: Croc Watch with Steve Backshall (克罗克·沃奇与史蒂夫·贝克沙尔)
programme.desc: Steve tries to find out if monster crocodiles can still thrive in the Reserve, and encounters five-metre-long Henry. But will he finally find the monster croc hes been searching for? (史蒂夫试图找出怪物鳄鱼是否仍然能在保留地中繁衍, 并遇到5米长的亨利。但是他最终能找到他一直在寻找的怪物?)

programme.title: Gordon Buchanan: My Epic Camel Adventure (戈登·布坎南:我的大卡梅尔冒险)
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan takes an epic camel ride across the Gobi Desert to discover how these most iconic, yet least understood, animals have adapted to survive in extreme environments. (戈登·布坎南骑着史无前例的骆驼穿越戈壁沙漠 发现这些最有象征意义的动物 是如何适应极端环境生存的)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson goes on a journey with Bear that involves a treacherous mountain range in Italy Kate shares details of her unique upbringing. (奥斯卡提名的女演员凯特·哈德逊 和熊一起旅行 涉及意大利的一个险恶山脉)

programme.title: Engineering Repurposed ((牛来))
programme.desc: Attend a concert in a hall that soars 50 metres into the sky, then dig 30 metres underground to explore a revolutionary farm. (在一个50米高的音乐厅上参加音乐会,然后在地下挖掘30米,)

programme.title: Asia (亚洲)
programme.desc: In the heart of Asia lie vast arid lands. These deserts and dry grasslands are so hostile, they push life to the limit. The animals that live here are some of the earths toughest. (亚洲的核心是广的干旱地.这些沙漠和干旱的草地是如此敌对,)

programme.desc: Caves contain some of the most dramatic and unusual phenomena in nature, including birds nests made from saliva and fish that cling to walls. (洞穴含有一些最戏剧性和最不寻常的自然现象,包括由唾液和粘在墙上的鱼构成的鸟巢。)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Acclaimed movie star Kate Winslet takes a role like never before, as Bear paramotors them both to the top of the Snowdonia Mountains in Wales. (著名的电影明星Kate Winslet 扮演了前所未有的角色 熊假体将她们 都带到威尔士斯诺多尼亚山顶)

programme.title: Whale with Steve Backshall ((与鲸共舞))
programme.desc: Steve returns home to the Atlantic waters of the British Isles as he considers the question of what humanity can do to ensure the enduring future of whales, which have already survived so much. (史蒂夫回到不列颠群岛大西洋水域时,他考虑了人类能够做些什么来确保鲸鱼的持久未来的问题,鲸鱼已经生存下来很多。)

programme.title: Big Adventures: Into the Amazon with Robson Green (大冒险:与Robson Green一起进入亚马逊)
programme.desc: Robson explores the stunningly beautiful Anavilhanas Archipelago in his canoe. An intricate pattern of tiny islands and lagoons, its a truly magical place, teeming with fish and bird life. (Robson在其独木舟中探索了惊人美丽的Anavilhanas群岛。一个由小岛和环礁湖组成的复杂模式,它是一个真正神奇的地方,充满了鱼类和鸟类的生命。)

programme.title: Hidden Frontiers: Arabia with Reza Pakravan (隐藏的边界:阿拉伯与雷扎·帕克拉万)
programme.desc: Reza explores the possibility of human habitation in an impenetrable canyon system in Oman. (雷萨探讨了人类居住在阿曼的一个难以透的峡谷系统的可能性.)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: Acclaimed movie star Kate Winslet takes a role like never before, as Bear paramotors them both to the top of the Snowdonia Mountains in Wales. (著名的电影明星Kate Winslet 扮演了前所未有的角色 熊假体将她们 都带到威尔士斯诺多尼亚山顶)

programme.title: Wild Sky ((中文))
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes. (扫描澳大利亚的天空,这些天空经常带来一些世界上最动荡的天气。 等待季风雨的降温,等待闪电点燃巨大的野火,对帮助野生动物应对这些极端现象的巧妙适应感到惊奇。)

programme.title: Wild Sky ((中文))
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family. (北美的北极熊在北极之光下寻找食物,绘制极地幽灵的冰冷路径图,并用一条草原犬家庭避开暴力龙卷风。)

programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))
programme.desc: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter. (当所有好莱坞女性的骄傲遇到游牧民族(新男性的骄傲)时,他们也许找到了他们交配的答案。但他们很快就意识到这不会是愉快的交配。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga. (北半球进入了秋天,而澳大利亚则见证了生命的重生,而交配的座头鲸填满了汤加温暖的热带海洋。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter. (也见证了11月一些最不可思议的自然事件, 从数以百万计的美王蝴蝶聚集在墨西哥的森林里, 到笼罩迪拜城的深雾中,)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems. (非洲最古老的树木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵树都有自己在旱季生存的战略。 香肠树和无花果树的季节性极端,为在贫瘠时期挣扎的动物提供食物和栖身之处。 作为回报,动物通过授粉花朵和分散种子来帮助这些树木繁殖。 非洲树木促进生命,并成为地球上最宝贵的生态系统之一的支柱。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation. (发现深受爱戴的香肠树的故事,它花蜜盛开,香肠制成的水果吸引各种动物,从昆虫到大象。 看看依赖这棵慷慨的树的动物如何确保它的扩散。)

programme.desc: Rejoin the team for some post-rainy-season drama as they search for Ferinha, Fera, and Badalo, whose tracking collars are missing. Meet a new biologist who helps Lizzie recollar the jaguars, adding a high-tech device that will record even more data. programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys (火山性奥德赛)
programme.desc: The number one tourist attraction on the island of Hawaii is a volcano called Kilauea. After a sudden collapse of the crater floor, a massive eruption drains the volcano of lava and now Kilauea is silent. Geologist Phillip Ong finally has his chance to explore. (夏威夷岛最大的旅游景点是一座称为Kilauea的火山。 在火山坑地板突然倒塌后,大规模火山爆发排出火山熔岩,现在,Kilauea沉默无声。 地质学家Philip Ong终于有机会探索了。)

programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))
programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey. (好莱坞的自豪感在游牧民野蛮袭击其领导人艾娃后再次出现,使她处于绝望的弱势,无法打猎。 更糟糕的是,她饥饿的骄傲开始拒绝她。 但是没有她,他们就为击败猎物而斗争。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom. (看着利隆圭野生动物团队试图释放两只保护猫。 一只猫逃出,然后受伤。 释放它们是否成功? 一个新的婴儿动脉在危急条件下到达,一只巨型猫头鹰飞向自由。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery. (加入Amanda的白拳灌木丛冒险活动,拯救被偷猎者偷猎的水桶。 与此同时,土狼收容中心被跳蚤咬耳朵治疗,而Alma却在深夜被神秘的猴子送来。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera. (在南澳大利亚州执行一个危险的拖拖任务,该任务将展示鲨鱼吃什么,为什么它们聚集在热点地区。 然后,当一个团队向北追赶老虎、公牛和锤头鲨鱼,并装配一个带有360度双角相机的鲨鱼。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches. (在一片迷雾的南非森林里,长了6百年的奥特尼夸黄木。在40米高的地方,她高在树冠上,是她这一类人中仅有的少数。 顺从她那迷人的故事,她的树枝是独特的生态系统。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga. (北半球进入了秋天,而澳大利亚则见证了生命的重生,而交配的座头鲸填满了汤加温暖的热带海洋。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexicos forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter. (也见证了11月一些最不可思议的自然事件, 从数以百万计的美王蝴蝶聚集在墨西哥的森林里, 到笼罩迪拜城的深雾中,)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals (捷日志)
programme.desc: Feel the heat as Lizzie and veterinarian Joares scramble to collar more jaguars amid storms, floods, and power outages. Try to pin down the elusive Badalo before his data-gathering tag drops off and meet a new female the team is eager to study. (利兹和兽医乔亚雷斯在暴风雨、洪水和停电中争吵着把更多的美洲虎锁起来。 在巴达洛的数据收集标签掉下来之前,先把他的难以捉摸的巴达洛钉住,然后见到一支新女性,小组渴望学习。)

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.
